## Notes

- v1: with cut_auroc at 0.86 (and sorted on hp1, hp2)

  - 42 features retained

- v2: without cut_auroc

  - best model is lasso, 13 features retained

## Set Up


```{r}

source("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/fun_eda.R?raw=true")
```

## Data

```{r}
ids <- read_csv(here::here(path_multilevel, "features_ids.csv")) |> glimpse()

  read_csv(here::here(path_models,

d <- read_csv(here::here(path_input,

```


## Modeling

### Population Model

```{r}
config <- configs_all |>
  arrange(desc(auroc)) |>
  slice(1) |>
  mutate(algorithm = params$algorithm)

algorithm <- config$algorithm
feature_set <- config$feature_set

if (config$resample == "none") {
  resample <- config$resample
} else {
  resample <- str_split(config$resample, "_")[[1]][1]
  ratio <- as.numeric(str_split(config$resample, "_")[[1]][2])
}


rec <- recipe(lapse ~ ., data = d) |>
  step_select(-dttm_label, -strat, -subid) |>
  # step_rm(ema_1.maxraw.p24) |> 
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  themis::step_downsample(lapse, under_ratio = ratio, seed = 10) |>
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) |> 
  step_rm(where(~ any(is.na(.)))) |> 
  step_nzv(all_predictors())

rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = d, retain = TRUE)

feat <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = NULL)
feat_out <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = d)
  
model_glmnet <- logistic_reg(
  penalty = config$hp2,
  mixture = config$hp1
) |> 
  set_engine("glmnet") |> 
    set_mode("classification") |> 
  fit(lapse ~ ., data = feat)
  
pred_prob_population <- predict(model_glmnet, feat_out, type = "prob")$`.pred_no lapse`
  
coeffs_population <- model_glmnet |> tidy() |> as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(term = if_else(term == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", term)) |> 
  select(-penalty) |> 
  filter(estimate != 0)


rm(rec, rec_prep, feat)
```

```{r}
model_glmnet |> write_rds(here::here(format_path("risk/models/multilevel"),
                              "model_glmnet_v2.rds"))
```


### Multilevel Model

```{r}
coeffs_lst <- coeffs_population |> 
  filter(term != "Intercept") |> 
  pull(term)

rec <- recipe(lapse ~ ., data = d) |>
  step_select(-dttm_label, -strat) |>
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors(), -subid) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE)

rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = d, retain = TRUE)

feat <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = NULL) |> 
  select(all_of(coeffs_lst), subid, lapse)
feat_out <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = d) |> 
  select(all_of(coeffs_lst), subid, lapse)

effects <- feat |>
  select(-subid, -lapse) |>
  names() |>
  paste(collapse = " + ")

brms_formula <- str_c("lapse ~ ", effects, " + (1 + ", effects, " | subid)")

model_glmer <- lme4::glmer(
  formula = as.formula(brms_formula),
  data = feat,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = lme4::glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)
```

## Train compact models


```{r}
walk(
  names(feat |> select(-subid, -lapse)),
  \(feat_excl) {
    
    feat_name <- str_replace_all(feat_excl, stringr::fixed("."), "_")
    
    file_path <- str_c(
      "~/Desktop/model_save/glmer/",
      feat_name,
      ".rds"
    )
    
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      message("Existing model found: ", feat_excl)
      
    } else {
      
      message("Fitting model: ", feat_excl)
      
      fixed_effects <- feat |>
        select(-c("subid", "lapse")) |>
        names() |> 
        paste(collapse = " + ")
      
      random_effects <- feat |> 
        select(-c("subid", "lapse", feat_excl)) |>
        names() |> 
        paste(collapse = " + ")
      
      brms_formula <- str_c(
        "lapse ~ ", fixed_effects,
        " + (1 + ", random_effects, " | subid)"
      )
      
      model_compact <- lme4::glmer(
        formula = as.formula(brms_formula),
        data = feat,
        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
        control = lme4::glmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
        )
      )
      
      write_rds(
        model_compact,
        file_path
      )
      
      rm(model_compact)
      gc()
    }
  }
)
```

```{r}
walk(
  names(feat |> select(-subid, -lapse)),
  \(feat_excl) {
    
    feat_name <- str_replace_all(feat_excl, stringr::fixed("."), "_")
    
    file_path <- str_c(
      "~/Desktop/model_save/",
      feat_name,
      ".rds"
    )
    
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      message("Existing model found: ", feat_excl)
      
    } else {
      
      message("Fitting model: ", feat_excl)
      
      fixed_effects <- feat |>
        select(-c("subid", "lapse")) |>
        names() |> 
        paste(collapse = " + ")
      
      random_effects <- feat |> 
        select(-c("subid", "lapse", feat_excl)) |>
        names() |> 
        paste(collapse = " + ")
      
      brms_formula <- str_c(
        "lapse ~ ", fixed_effects,
        " + (1 + ", random_effects, " | subid)"
      )
      
      model_compact <- brm(
        formula = as.formula(brms_formula),
        data = feat,
        family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
        prior = c(
          set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b"),
          set_prior("normal(-2.5, 1)", class = "Intercept"),
          set_prior("exponential(1)", class = "sd")
        ),
        init = 0,
        chains = 4,
        iter = 5000,
        warmup = 2000,
        cores = 4,
        seed = 123,
        control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
        save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
      )
      
      write_rds(
        model_compact,
        file_path
      )
      
      rm(model_compact)
      gc()
    }
  }
)
```


## Sanity check

### Probabilities

**Compare population level model to multilevel model**

Quick compare of predicted probabilities
```{r}
probs <- tibble(
  multilevel = 1 - pred_prob_multilevel,
  multilevel_fixed = 1 - pred_prob_multilevel_fixed,
  population = 1 - pred_prob_population
)

cor(probs$multilevel, probs$population)
cor(probs$multilevel_fixed, probs$population)

ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = probs, aes(x = population, y = multilevel)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red",
                linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "Population-Level Model Predicted Probability",
         y = "Multilevel Model Predicted Probability")

ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = probs, aes(x = population, y = multilevel_fixed)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red",
                linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "Population-Level Model Predicted Probability",
         y = "Multilevel Model Predicted Probability")
```

### Parameters


```{r}
coeffs <- coeffs_population |> 
  rename(population = estimate) |> 
  right_join(coeffs_multilevel |> rename(multilevel = Estimate),
             by = "term") |> 
  select(term, population, multilevel)

coeffs

# cor(coeffs$multilevel, coeffs$population)

mean(coeffs$multilevel - coeffs$population)
```

optimize vs. retained features
```{r}
coeffs_optimize$term
coeffs$term
```

higher variance in parameter estimates for multilevel vs. population

```{r}
coeffs |> 
  group_by(term) |> 
  summarize(
    multilevel_mean = mean(multilevel),
    multilevel_sd = sd(multilevel),
    population_mean = mean(population),
    population_sd = sd(population)
  ) |> 
  print_kbl()
```

```{r}
coeffs |> 
  arrange(term) |> 
  print_kbl()

coeffs |> 
  mutate(diff = multilevel - population) |> 
  arrange(desc(abs(diff))) |> 
  print_kbl()

coeffs |> 
  mutate(diff = multilevel - population) |> 
  group_by(term) |> 
  summarize(
    diff_mean = mean(diff),
    diff_sd = sd(diff)
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(abs(diff_mean))) |> 
  print_kbl()
```

```{r}
                       "random_effects_v2.csv"))
```
